topic: Staying invested through market ups and downs
judge_note: A concrete parent moment (a college fee 15 years away) with a hopeful tone. It is clear in one second, though not very local.

slides.headline: Your child's college fee is 15 years away.
slides.subhead: One small envelope each month turns waiting into a plan.

points.title: Market noise passes
points.text: Some months it falls, others it climbs. Your monthly amount stays steady.

points.title: Small habits add up
points.text: 5,000 rupees monthly for 10 years means 6,00,000 rupees added by you. Illustration only, not returns.

points.title: Skip the waiting trap
points.text: Waiting for the perfect time is also a decision. Months slip by quietly.

slides.headline: Send this to someone waiting.
slides.footnote: Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks. Read all scheme documents carefully.
